text: It's do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do. That's what father used to teach me many years ago. Do means money. Ain't it funny? Everywhere we go, it's do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do. Three girls were once debating on the kind of man they'd wed. I'd like a man who stays at home. The first one quickly said. The second said she'd like a man whose love would
